about: One entry per build of the web app, newest first. build = the number in the service worker cache name (docs/sw.js). Add an entry with every change; scripts/make_changelog.py writes CHANGELOG.md from this file.

releases.title: Who pushes, on the folded GitHub block
changes: Vibe: folded, the GitHub minutes block still says which account this computer pushes as, next to the percent used (#56)

releases.title: Which GitHub account this computer pushes as
changes: Vibe: where the GitHub CLI is signed in to several accounts, a chip per account under the GitHub meters picks the one this computer pushes as. git, the GitHub CLI and an assistant working there all follow it, and a switch made in a terminal shows on the page (#55)
cairn vibe github push-as says which account pushes, and with a name switches to it (#55)

releases.title: GitHub minutes of a second account
changes: Vibe: a meter of GitHub Actions minutes for every account you are signed in to, not only the main one. Name the others with cairn vibe watch --github-account NAME (#53)
Vibe: hand a private repo to another of your accounts from the meter, so its minutes count there. GitHub mails the new owner to confirm, and the old owner keeps push access (#53)

releases.title: Dashboard buttons from the phone
changes: Dashboards on phone: a dashboard's buttons can run on your PC. Each press runs once, is refused when it is older than 5 minutes, and is taken back when the PC does not pick it up (#51)
Dashboards on phone: the open tab and folded blocks of a dashboard stay as they were when a newer copy arrives (#51)

releases.title: Version history
changes: Version history inside the app: every build with its date and what changed. Open it at the bottom of the sidebar, from Settings or from the command palette (#50)

releases.title: Journal per day, several computers
changes: Journal: one line per day, mood worked out for you, any period, and its own sidebar entry (#48)
Vibe: several computers in one brain with a device switch; a Mac can run the watcher (#49)
Every remaining page is made of blocks with a dashboard and a recap (#47)

releases.title: Blocks you fold and arrange
changes: Vibe blocks you fold and arrange, shared through the brain; the sidebar goes from 9 entries to 6; Founder Studio leaves Cairn (#45)
Vibe: a session works or is finished, never waits; one live list; Projects, People and Proof as blocks; 5 sidebar entries (#46)

releases.title: Smooth phone map, public page
changes: The phone map stays smooth on a big brain, a Telegram bot reports Cairn's status daily, UI tidy (#43)
A public page you can host anywhere: cairn publish --site (#44)

releases.title: Faster Vibe, GitHub minutes
changes: Vibe shows the computer (CPU, memory, power, time since restart) and effort follows its real load
The Vibe page never waits on git or on the computer reading, and no longer re-reads every note per poll
GitHub Actions minutes against the free limit, with a warning near it and a history
Autopilot: a lost connection no longer blocks a job, it waits and tries again
Desktop: updates apply even when git is slow; chat opens without waiting for the model list
Phone: any-network sign-in opens on Vibe, the app reloads into new versions, a GitHub brain loads every session
Plugin catalogue: Kilat 0.2.3 (#42)

releases.title: Tokens, models and sharing
changes: The Vibe watcher reads OpenCode 2.2: model, effort, tokens and turn state
Vibe stats: tokens, usage per model, prompts, active days and streak
A live recap band; continue an OpenCode session or start a chat in its folder from the recap
A share card for the last 14 days (story and square picture)
People: friends and a leaderboard from totals you choose to share

releases.title: Dashboards on the phone, MCP Registry
changes: Dashboards on the phone: cairn dashboards publishes local dashboard pages to the private relay repo, on a schedule
The home-screen app opens your brain signed in, with live sync for brains opened from GitHub
A Cairn tile for the iPhone widget (#41)
Published to the official MCP Registry as a bundle; every MCP tool declares its hints
Plugin catalogue: Kilat 0.2.2 (#40)

releases.title: Sign in by QR, several PCs on one relay
changes: Sign in a phone by QR code from Settings, on any network
Several PCs on one relay: the phone picks which one to talk to
Signed-in browsers reopen the last brain, so phone, laptop and PC show the same Map and Live
Big vaults open fast (notes fetched 100 per call), with a loading message while a brain opens
Plugins: Kilat, calculations with units, joins the catalogue (#35, #36)
Minimum Python is 3.13 (#38)

releases.title: Phone and chat
changes: Pair a phone by QR code to watch Cairn from it
Phone access from any network through Tailscale
Live sync between phone and PC
Chat with your OpenCode models from any device, also through a private GitHub relay repo
A live progress bar, time left and effort for running sessions

releases.title: Hubs, projects and databases
changes: Sidebar: 17 entries become 8 hubs with tabs inside the page (#30)
Projects ranking, Notion-style databases and a / menu (#31)
Vibe: an overview band with every status at a glance and what is running now (#32)
Founder Studio follows Cairn's controls and theme (#28, #29, #33)
The local server still answers when the git check stalls (#34)

releases.title: MCP, precedent and autopilot
changes: cairn mcp connects AI assistants, and stays fast on vaults of 2,000 notes (#17)
Precedent and autopilot inside Cairn (#19, #23)
Vibe: honest numbers at 286 sessions, 'code changed' for detected sessions, tap a figure to have it explained (#18, #21, #22)
Phones: the Log button sits in thumb reach and tucks away while you read (#24)
Founder Studio page: run the buyer panel inside Cairn (#26, #27)

releases.title: Sessions found on their own, offline voice
changes: Vibe finds OpenCode and Vector sessions by itself (#12)
Voice log: offline voice on the device, recall of any day, voice search, a 12-month heatmap (#13)
Vibe: clock-time totals, commit evidence, history grouped by day (#14)
Vibe: outcome filters, days that fold, and the desktop app runs the watcher (#15)
Voice log: monthly review, reviews that are due, days that read alike (#16)

releases.title: Obsidian, canvas, voice log and Vibe
changes: Obsidian import and two-way sync, and a live interactive map (#1)
Proof of work page and a design pass (#2)
Obsidian parity: callouts, embeds, split view, link suggestions, rename, properties, folders, templates, a first-run tour (#3)
The desktop app updates itself, no restarts by hand (#4)
Sync through office proxies, auto-publish of the public brain, maths and diagrams (#5)
Canvas, tabs and community plugins (#6, #9)
Voice daily log: mic button, spoken commands, 'Hey Cairn', languages, @people (#10, #11)
Vibe: live AI coding sessions, results, stats, feedback and skill runs (#8)

releases.title: Desktop app and the map
changes: Desktop app for Windows: one-click installer, tray icon, sync, open and settings inside the app
Map: filters, local maps, paths, suggested links, keyboard navigation; opens Obsidian vaults as they are
The map in 2D or 3D
Continue with GitHub sign-in
Design pass: map labels never overlap, 320 px phones fit

releases.title: First release
changes: Cairn 1.0: a second brain that lives inside your repo
People: explore GitHub profiles and read-only brains
Sign in with GitHub and edit your brain from any device
